question: Montre-moi l'évolution des ventes de BMW électriques en Chine depuis 2018
code:
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
df = pd.read_csv('data/processed/bmw_cleaned.csv')
df_filtered = df[(df['country'] == 'China') & (df['powertrain'] == 'BEV') & (df['year'] >= 2018)]
grouped = df_filtered.groupby('year')['sales'].sum().reset_index()
fig = px.line(grouped, x='year', y='sales', title='Évolution ventes BMW électriques en Chine depuis 2018')
print(f'Chiffres clés: Total ventes = {grouped["sales"].sum()}')
print('Explication: Les ventes ont augmenté grâce à la transition électrique en Chine.')
fig.show()

question: Quels sont les 10 modèles qui ont le plus progressé en Europe en 2024 vs 2023 ?
code:
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
df = pd.read_csv('data/processed/bmw_cleaned.csv')
df_2023 = df[(df['year'] == 2023) & (df['region'] == 'Europe')].groupby('model')['sales'].sum().reset_index()
df_2024 = df[(df['year'] == 2024) & (df['region'] == 'Europe')].groupby('model')['sales'].sum().reset_index()
merged = pd.merge(df_2024, df_2023, on='model', suffixes=('_2024', '_2023'))
merged['growth'] = merged['sales_2024'] - merged['sales_2023']
top10 = merged.nlargest(10, 'growth')
fig = px.bar(top10, x='model', y='growth', title='Top 10 modèles progression Europe 2024 vs 2023')
print(f'Chiffres clés: Max growth = {top10["growth"].max()}')
print('Explication: Focus sur SUV et électriques.')
fig.show()

question: Compare les ventes diesel vs essence en Allemagne et en France depuis 2020
code:
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
df = pd.read_csv('data/processed/bmw_cleaned.csv')
df_filtered = df[(df['year'] >= 2020) & (df['country'].isin(['Germany', 'France'])) & (df['powertrain'].isin(['DIESEL', 'GASOLINE']))]
grouped = df_filtered.groupby(['year', 'country', 'powertrain'])['sales'].sum().reset_index()

print('Explication: Baisse diesel en Europe due aux normes.')
fig.show()

question: Quels pays ont vu leurs ventes totales BMW baisser de plus de 15% en 2023 ?
code:
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
df = pd.read_csv('data/processed/bmw_cleaned.csv')
df_2022 = df[df['year'] == 2022].groupby('country')['sales'].sum().reset_index()
df_2023 = df[df['year'] == 2023].groupby('country')['sales'].sum().reset_index()
merged = pd.merge(df_2023, df_2022, on='country', suffixes=('_2023', '_2022'))
merged['pct_change'] = (merged['sales_2023'] - merged['sales_2022']) / merged['sales_2022'] * 100
dropped = merged[merged['pct_change'] < -15]
fig = px.bar(dropped, x='country', y='pct_change', title='Pays avec baisse >15% en 2023')
print(f'Chiffres clés: {len(dropped)} pays affectés')
print('Explication: Impact économique ou transition électrique.')
fig.show()

question: Part de marché électrique par région en 2024
code:
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
df = pd.read_csv('data/processed/bmw_cleaned.csv')
df_2024 = df[df['year'] == 2024]
total_by_region = df_2024.groupby('region')['sales'].sum().reset_index(name='total')
electric_by_region = df_2024[df_2024['powertrain'] == 'BEV'].groupby('region')['sales'].sum().reset_index(name='electric')
merged = pd.merge(total_by_region, electric_by_region, on='region')
merged['share'] = merged['electric'] / merged['total'] * 100
fig = px.pie(merged, values='share', names='region', title='Part BEV par région 2024')
fig.show()
